title: Cochain realization of external cup on fixed scalar resolution models
statement: Let k be a field, f:X -> Spec(k), g:Y -> Spec(k), and F,G quasi-coherent modules. Form the explicit scalar models A,B and product model C of [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model]. There exists a cochain map c:Tot(A tensor_k B) -> C with IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F G c: after the canonical model-to-scalar-cohomology comparisons, H(c) on every tensor-cycle class in degree p+q is externalCup of the two factor classes. This asserts neither injectivity nor surjectivity of H(c), and has no compactness or affine-diagonal hypothesis.

proof.text: Use the recorded scalar externalCup, represented by the signed resolution pairing of Tags 01FD, 07MB and 0FKV and the coefficient augmentation. It is k-bilinear, since exact scalar inverse image, exact-functor transport on Ext and Ext composition are k-linear in each variable. This part does not use geometric invertibility.

Apply the field-linear tensor Kunneth map of [lem-sc-qcoh-cech-total-tensor-nat-iso] to A and B. Define a linear map on their tensor-total homology by externalCup on every summand, using the factor and product model comparisons.

In each degree choose complements of boundaries in cycles and of cycles in the term. Projection from a complex to its homology representatives, and inclusion of these representatives, are cochain maps inducing identity on homology. Compose the source projection with the previous graded homology map and the target inclusion. This lifts the graded map to c without any quasi-isomorphism assertion. The tensor Kunneth cycle formula gives its normalization, and monicity of iCycles handles any z with the specified inclusion.

theorem picardExternalCupCochain_exists
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ∃ c : picardExternalTotal f g F G ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G),
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F G c
